items.text: One of the best Myanmar dining experiences in Bangkok. The atmosphere is warm and elegant, service is attentive without being overbearing. Every dish came out perfectly timed.
As a Myanmar local, this place gets everything right — the flavours, the presentation, the hospitality. It genuinely feels like eating in Yangon but with a refined touch.
Brought clients here for a business dinner and everyone was impressed. The interior is beautiful, staff speak good English, and the food quality is consistently high across the board.
Really enjoyed the evening here. Cosy setting, well-curated menu and the staff were genuinely knowledgeable about each dish. Slightly pricey but worth it for a special occasion.
The restaurant is tucked away in a quiet soi but absolutely worth finding. Clean, well-lit space with a relaxed vibe. Staff were friendly and gave great recommendations.
Solid fine dining spot with genuine Myanmar character. The decor is tasteful and not overdone. Only issue was parking nearby is difficult on weekends — recommend taking BTS.
Celebrating my anniversary here was perfect. The staff arranged a small surprise for us without being asked. That kind of thoughtfulness is rare. Will be back for every anniversary.
Food quality is genuinely high and the space is lovely. But on a busy Friday evening the wait was nearly 40 minutes even with a reservation. Hope management improves the pacing.
Clean, calm and full of character. The staff took time to explain the origin of each dish which made the whole experience educational as well as delicious. Highly recommend for first-timers.
Great place to introduce friends to Myanmar cuisine. The menu is well explained, staff are patient with questions and the overall experience feels thoughtfully put together.

items.text: This little stall inside Pratunam market is the most authentic Mandalay food spot I've found in Bangkok. No frills, no pretension — just proper home-style cooking and very fair prices.
A proper neighbourhood gem. The owner is warm, always around to chat and genuinely cares that you enjoy your meal. That personal touch makes this place stand out.
I eat here at least once a week. The quality never drops, the portions are generous and you always leave full and happy. Best value Myanmar food in the whole Ratchathewi area.
Very tasty and affordable. The market setting is lively and fun but it does get loud and crowded during lunch hour. Go early or after 1pm for a more comfortable experience.
Stumbled across this place while shopping at Pratunam and it completely made my day. The staff were welcoming to a foreigner, pointed me to the right dishes and the food was outstanding.
Consistently good food and quick service even when busy. Seating is limited so be prepared to share a table, but nobody minds — it adds to the communal market atmosphere.
This place makes me feel at home every single visit. The recipes are clearly passed down and made with care. For Myanmar people living in Bangkok, this is a real comfort spot.
Food is genuinely delicious and the price is unbeatable. But the space is cramped and ventilation inside the market isn't great on hot days. Definitely worth it in cooler weather.
One of those rare finds that locals know about but tourists haven't discovered yet. Simple setup, honest food, great prices. I've already recommended it to everyone I know in Bangkok.
Run by a family from Mandalay and it shows in every detail — the recipes, the hospitality, the pride in what they serve. One of the most genuine dining experiences in Bangkok.
